item.title: Red-Teaming Auto Mode: Improving Blocking Classifiers Against Malign Coding Agents
item.description:
发表方：Anthropic　发布：2026-09-18　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：生产编码 agent 都有“阻断式监控”（Claude Code 的 Auto Mode、Codex 的 Guardian）逐步审查动作——但若被监控的 agent 本身持续恶意，这些监控扛得住吗？

方法：红队实验：让对抗 agent 在获得高层攻击策略后，试图绕过生产监控造成灾难性危害（如窃取自身权重）。可行机制包括 agent 对监控器生成 prompt 注入、多 agent 协同攻击、恶意 compaction。

关键数字：79% 的试验中，agent 能用注入攻击骗过 Auto Mode 与 Guardian 执行任意 bash 命令；改进工具覆盖、转录格式与 agentic 监控阶段可大幅强化 Auto Mode，但可接受成本下防住多上下文攻击仍是开放问题。代码开源。

为什么值得看：agent 安全从“防注入”升级到“防被监控对象本身”，做编码 agent 上线评审的团队需把这类攻击纳入清单。

原文：Red-Teaming Auto Mode: Improving Blocking Classifiers Against Malign Coding Agents

item.title: CircleMatch: Prototype Matching with Circular Temporal Statistics for Tiny Keyword Spotting
item.description:
发表方：arXiv（学术机构）　发布：2026-09-17　分类：论文PDF

极小参数量关键词唤醒（KWS）原型匹配框架；非头部机构论文，与语音唤醒方向相关，附列参考

Keyword spotting (KWS), the task of identifying predefined words in speech, is a core capability of voice-enabled devices. Achieving high KWS accuracy under tight parameter budgets across different vocabulary sizes remains challenging. We present CircleMatch, a matching framework enabling KWS with very few parameters. Its encoder independently compresses frequency bands and fuses them into frame features. These features are then matched against learned class-specific prototypes to produce temporal response curves. Parameter-free circular aggregation encodes time as angles and summarizes response distributions and relative timing for classification. We develop four tiny variants, Circle-D4, Circle-D8, Circle-D16, and Circle-D32, ranging from approximately 1k to 7k parameters in the 12-class setting. Experiments with multiple random seeds on Speech Commands v1/v2 and the English and Spanish Micro subsets of the Multilingual Spoken Words Corpus demonstrate competitive accuracy with tiny models. Our qualitative analysis further suggests approximate shift equivariance of prototype responses and adaptation to temporal compression. Code and model weights are available at https://github.co…

item.title: xTwin-R1: RL Post-Training for Domain-Specific LLM-based Digital Twins
item.description:
发表方：Microsoft　发布：2026-09-16　分类：论文PDF

RL后训练框架让LLM数字孪生学会领域动作表示，用于业务用户行为模拟

Ensemble nitrogen-vacancy (NV) diamond magnetometers combine high sensitivity with vector-field reconstruction, but practical deployment is limited by errors arising from high-frequency laser noise during short-duration operations and slow-varying gain fluctuations and offset drift during long-term operation. Here, we present an integrated digital architecture for achieving NV magnetometry stability across distinct timescales. A dynamic differential readout continuously balances fluorescence and reference channels to suppress correlated laser noise. Second-derivative Lorentzian lineshape tracking enables in-situ correction of slope variations arising from slow changes in gain and optical excitation. We further identify temperature-induced bias-magnet fluctuations as a dominant source of long-term drift and introduce a magnetic eigenvector transformation that uses the intrinsic response of NV resonances to eliminate these variations. We show, under unshielded ambient conditions, that this architecture achieves an off-resonance noise factor of 1.0 $\pm$ 0.1, matching the fundamental limit with ten-fold suppression of long-term drift, enabling stable, field-ready quantum magnetometry.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Verifiable Social Reasoning for LLM-Based Assistants
item.description:
发表方：Google　发布：2026-09-16　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：LLM 助手大量承担日常社交咨询，但社交推理难评测：既要让助手从用户主观叙述中了解社交情境，社交属性（如他人意图）又通常缺乏可验证真值。

方法：Google 提出 Fuse 多智能体模拟框架：一个带隐藏动机的目标智能体与其他智能体（含代表用户的智能体）交互后，用户去咨询受评测的助手推断目标动机——构造上天然提供可验证真值。模拟忠实度经 24k 人工标注研究验证，框架与 21k 样本数据集均已开源。

关键数字：应用于 12 个 LLM；24k 人工标注；开源 21k 样本。

为什么值得看：四个系统性发现很有信息量：用户中介会复合社交推理难度；LLM 对有偏的用户框架系统性敏感；模型可能比人类需要更多细节才能正确预测；更长的对话不一定带来更好的表现（尽管给了追问机会）。

item.title: The Price of the Prompt: Quantifying Implicit Costs in Natural Language Programming
item.description:
发表方：Google　发布：2026-09-16　分类：论文PDF

实证研究：自然语言编程相比 Python 在 token 消耗、执行时延与可靠性上的隐性成本量化

In thin-film lithium niobate Mach-Zehnder modulators, half-wave voltage and bandwidth are tied to the same design parameters; hence, improving one usually costs the other. Several methods have been pursued in the past to alleviate this tradeoff. Specifically, the bias voltage can be reduced through non-centered placement of optical waveguides with respect to electrodes, slow-wave optical gratings, and high-permittivity cladding layers. Bandwidth can be enhanced through implementing periodic segmented electrodes and exploiting low-permittivity bottom cladding and substrate materials. The objective of this work is to study the augmentative impact of these methods. We pursue a rigorous modeling and optimization approach to achieve this objective, estimate the impact of each augmentation, and evaluate the ultimate performance of TFLN MZMs based on these methods. It is shown that a co-designed structure that incorporates all these enhancing methods can attain a drive voltage of 0.84 V and a modulation bandwidth of almost 220 GHz.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: SongCraft: Unified Song Generation and Editing
item.description:
发表方：Meta　发布：2026-09-16　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：歌曲生成与歌曲编辑历来被当作两个独立任务处理，现有编辑方法往往需要噪声注入再生成，或依赖精心构造的成对训练数据——能否用一个模型统一"谱曲生成 + 细粒度编辑"？

方法：Meta 提出 SongCraft：基于重建式预训练，让模型学习从可变数量的可解释条件重建音频——给文本/歌词就学多样化生成，给细粒度音乐属性就学重建目标，进而通过单独修改某一属性实现编辑。模型为 latent flow matching 架构，并引入词级音素对齐（改善发音学习并加速收敛）、节拍条件、VAE 潜空间表征对齐三项技术。

关键数字：在评测的歌曲生成基线中取得最低词错误率（WER），同时保持有竞争力的音质；单模型支持歌词、人声旋律、节拍、歌手身份四类编辑。

为什么值得看：把"生成"与"编辑"统一到同一重建式预训练框架里的思路，对音频之外的生成式建模（视频、语音合成）也有迁移价值。

item.title: SLMTune: Enhancing Pre-Trained Spoken Language Models with Lightweight Text Recovery Augmentation
item.description:
发表方：Google　发布：2026-09-16　分类：论文PDF

轻量文本恢复增强（TRA）方法：用<1%可训练参数缓解语音模型灾难性遗忘，ASR提升22%

Although aerial-legged robots offer combined agility and efficiency, controlling high-speed hopping under complex hybrid dynamics is challenging. Reinforcement Learning (RL) is promising but prone to energy-inefficient "reward hacking". We propose a Dynamics-Informed RL framework for a monopedal hopping quadcopter. By embedding a target Specific Energy into the reward, we constrain the optimization to a physically viable energy manifold, ensuring stable hopping behaviour. By rewarding the phase-consistent behavior, it can encourage bio-inspired stance-phase impulse. Furthermore, penalizing the electro-mechanical power waste induces the motors generate an efficient impulse. This enables the policy to inject energy strictly during spring restitution without heuristic state machines. MuJoCo simulations validate robust height regulation and forward velocity tracking up to 2.0 m/s despite severe attitude-contact coupling. Ultimately, our approach yields a highly agile hopping gait, reducing energy consumption by 82% and 73% compared to hovering baselines and inefficiency baseline, respectively.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Register Tokens for Bounded-State Reasoning in Diffusion Language Models
item.description:
发表方：Microsoft　发布：2026-09-16　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：掩码扩散语言模型（dLLM）逐块生成文本时，跨块推理通常要把已生成文本留在上下文里——能否清空前文后仅靠一个定长携带状态继续推理？

方法：Register Tokens：少量固定位置的专用 token，其连续隐状态被训练为跨生成块携带推理进度。后训练流程：解码一块文本→清空该块但保留 register 值→仅凭 prompt 与携带状态继续解码；register 还可在长程推理任务上用强化学习进一步精炼。

关键数字：在 LLaDA 与 Dream 上的主要对比中，register 携带在所有 benchmark 上优于离散文本携带，数学最高提升 8.5 分、代码最高提升 19.5 分；对正确程序常跨多块的有界代码生成尤其有效。

为什么值得看：给扩散 LM 补上了"定长记忆"这块短板——不靠拉长上下文而靠压缩状态延续推理，是降低 dLLM 长程推理成本的一条新路。

item.title: QuanText: Protecting Dataset-Level Secrets in Textual Data Sharing
item.description:
发表方：Microsoft Research / CMU　发布：2026-09-16　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：发布文本数据集可能泄露"数据集级秘密"（如某诊断、性别或立场的记录占比），差分隐私对这类聚合属性保护很弱——如何在保住数据效用的同时防泄露？

方法：QuanText（Randomized Quantization for Text）：免训练、与具体 LLM 无关的数据发布机制。给定要保护的秘密属性与要保效用的属性，构造秘密/非秘密属性的候选发布分布，随机选一个与私有经验分布足够近的，再用原文中与属性相关的片段改写每条样本以匹配所选分布；理论框架基于 Statistic Maximal Leakage（SML）。

关键数字：摘要未给具体数值；在理想条件下证明满足 SML 保证，并在真实数据集上取得优于对比数据生成基线的经验隐私-效用权衡。

为什么值得看："数据集级隐私"是文本数据共享中少有人处理但实务很痛的点（医疗、舆情数据尤甚），免训练、可解释的机制落地门槛低。

item.description:
发表方：Microsoft　发布：2026-09-16　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：LLM 能从经验中学习，但原始解题轨迹又长又噪，直接回放指导效果差——如何提炼出真正可用的经验知识？

方法：Learning to Coach（L2C）：actor 模型冻结，另训一个 LLM-as-a-Coach 专门从其历史轨迹中提炼可执行的经验指导；教练以"actor 在其指导下答对"为奖励训练，分 same-instance（改进原题后续回答）与 cross-instance（提炼可迁移到其他题的知识）两种奖励。

关键数字：摘要未给具体数值；报告称在数学推理与交互式文本游戏上稳定超过 self-refinement 与未训练教练基线，增加经验学习迭代比加大 actor 解码预算更划算，训练后的教练还能迁移到 OOD 任务并适配特定 actor。

为什么值得看：把"从经验学习"从粗暴回放轨迹升级为专门训练的教练模块，并给出推理时算力分配的新结论——同样预算投给教练迭代比堆解码更值。

A \emph{linear sketch} is a randomized linear mapping of a vector $v$ to a lower dimensional sketch vector, designed to preserve relevant information about $v$. We consider sketches of vectors $v \in Z^u$ (for $u \in N$), designed for exact recovery of $v$ from its sketch. Concretely, our \emph{Stuffed IBLT} is a linear sketch configured with a capacity $n \in N$ and a multiplicity limit $L \in N$ and will recover $v$ with high probability whenever $||v||_0 \leq n$ and $||v||_\infty \leq L$. The sketch can be maintained efficiently under unrestricted updates to $v$, i.e., $v$ is not subject to any constraints in between decoding requests. This makes the sketch useful for streaming algorithms and for solving the (multi)set reconciliation problem. In the present paper, we study the maximization problem of the $k$-Torsional rigidity under quermassintegral constraint, with particular emphasis on the role of the ball. Our main result shows a phenomenon which, as far as we know, has not previously been observed: the ball, rather than being an extremal shape, is a saddle point. More precisely, for suitable quermassintegral constraints, we show that the $k$-torsional rigidity admits both increasing and decreasing perturbations around the ball. The proof is based on a second-order analysis of the corresponding variational problem. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first use of a second-order shape derivative approach in the study of variational problems for $k$-Hessian operators. We also establish an analogous saddle-point behavior for a related curvature functional under a volume constraint, highlighting a structural distinction between the intermediate Hessian regime and the classical Laplace and Monge-Ampère cases.

Incorporating dynamical fermions is a central challenge for diffusion samplers of lattice gauge theories. We propose an analytic pseudofermion sampler based on continuous Hasenbusch transport as a component for gauge diffusion. The construction uses shifted linear solves and a finite-path correction, requiring neither explicit fermion determinant evaluation nor a learned pseudofermion model. We demonstrate the coupling in the two-flavour Schwinger model without neural networks, obtaining corrected physical observables compatible with independent references. We also show why accurate covariance transport can leave large weight fluctuations, tracing them to the backward transition density. This analysis leads to a correction based on the Wilson operator trace that reduces log-weight variance without changing the generated fields or increasing the number of Dirac operator applications. The predicted improvement is verified on previously unused gauge backgrounds. These results provide an analytic option for incorporating fermions in gauge diffusion and a guide to controlling its correction weights.

item.title: Lost in Perception: Isolating Perceptual and Reasoning Failures in Multimodal Physics
item.description:
发表方：arXiv（多机构）　发布：2026-07-17　分类：论文PDF

v1 投稿于 7 月 17 日，非 24h 新内容，不入库

Multimodal LLMs report strong performance on scientific reasoning benchmarks, yet most treat perception and reasoning as a single measurable process. We introduce a five-task diagnostic experiment across physics and geometry benchmarks that isolates failures to perception, reasoning, or both. Incorrect diagram interpretation degrades performance even on problems models solve correctly from text alone, and accuracy generally rises from raw images to human-authored captions. Recovery under corrected captions is high for some models, separating perception-blocked failures from genuine reasoning bottlenecks. Which reasoning error follows a perception failure depends on domain: physics failures resolve into calculation errors, geometry into conceptual misapplication. As a discussion beyond our core experiments, InternS1-mini, despite heavy scientific pretraining and thinking capabilities, falls below the weakest model from experiments on every task, with reasoning traces frequently truncating before completion.
